name: Armyansk-Dzhankoi Gas Pipeline
researcher_notes: A UNIAN report of 15 September 2011 says the company Zangas-NGS finished the linear part of the Armyansk-Dzhankoi high-pressure trunk line. Length is 72.5 km. Zangas-NGS was the turnkey general contractor for Ukrtransgaz. The report says the line will carry up to 4.5 bcm a year of extra gas to Crimea and the owner planned to hand it over by the end of 2011. A Neftegaz.ru analysis of 12 February 2015 says the line, diameter 1000 mm, passed in 2014 to Chornomornaftogaz, which now runs it, and that it is less than 10 years old, so it was operating then. No GEM row has an Armyansk or Dzhankoi end, so this is not a match to an existing row. Crimea counts as Ukraine under the naming conventions. Chornomornaftogaz is an occupying-power operator since 2014 and is noted as such, not recorded as the Ukrainian operator. The exact commissioning date was not found. Start year is left blank. Current operating status after 2022 was not checked in a recent source, so the tier is medium. The Crimea-region fields (StartState/Province) are left blank. The 4.5 bcm/y is the added capacity stated in the 2011 report, not a confirmed design rating. The 700 million hryvnia cost is for the total project (2003 contract) and is not staged. No route found; route not mapped.
